name: dense-directional
hypothesis: A matched-capacity interface can retain useful acceptance with lower deployed parameter count; explicit L2 may improve fitting validation.
falsifier: Nonfinite fitting or checkpoint failure invalidates the path; worse validation and acceptance without a cost benefit rejects promotion.
promotion: Pilot: finite gradients, saved/reloaded checkpoint, diagnostics and complete paired outputs. Directional: useful validation/acceptance or deployment-cost tradeoff; full-answer quality requires separate evaluation.
